scope: canonical exposure-strategy registry; ladder, pair and event-replay runners remain separate

strategies.name: ADX-Filtered Trend
strategies.summary: Long only while a directional trend is both present (ADX) and up (+DI > -DI).

strategies.name: ATR-Normalised Position Sizing
strategies.summary: Trend entry sized so one ATR of adverse move costs a fixed fraction of equity.

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Breakout
strategies.summary: Long a close above the upper Bollinger band, with an optional volatility-squeeze pre-filter.

strategies.name: Bollinger Mean-Reversion
strategies.summary: Buy a close below the lower Bollinger band, exit on reversion to the mid. Same inequality as zscore.

strategies.name: Donchian Channel Breakout
strategies.summary: Long on a new n-bar high, flat on an m-bar low. The Turtle mechanism.

strategies.name: Buy & Hold
strategies.summary: Fully invested from the first tradeable bar. The null hypothesis every other card must beat.

strategies.name: Dollar-Cost Averaging (instalment ramp)
strategies.summary: Deploy a fixed budget in equal instalments at a fixed bar interval; exposure ramps to 1.0. The guides' DCA, expressed as an exposure target.

strategies.name: Dual Momentum (12-1)
strategies.summary: Trailing formation-window return excluding the most recent bars, to skip short-term reversal.

strategies.name: EMA Crossover (golden cross)
strategies.summary: Long while the fast EMA is above the slow EMA. At 50/200 this is the golden cross the guides describe.

strategies.name: Fibonacci Retracement Pullback
strategies.summary: Buy a pullback into the 0.382-0.786 retracement zone of an up-swing once price turns up; exit on the swing high or a break of the zone.

strategies.name: EWMA / GARCH(1,1) Vol-Targeted Trend
strategies.summary: Vol-targeted trend using an EWMA variance forecast instead of a trailing stdev.

strategies.name: Long-Only Grid (exposure staircase)
strategies.summary: Staircase accumulation as price falls below a rolling anchor. NOT the extension's resting-order ladder.

strategies.name: Variance-Ratio / Hurst Regime Switch
strategies.summary: A meta-signal: measure whether the series trends or reverts, then run the matching rule.

strategies.name: Ichimoku Cloud
strategies.summary: Long while price is above the cloud that was projected onto this bar displacement bars ago.

strategies.name: Keltner Channel Breakout
strategies.summary: Breakout of an ATR-width channel around an EMA. Like Bollinger, but its volatility measure sees gaps.

strategies.name: Leverage tier, high margin
strategies.summary: Runs any registered long/flat strategy as a Jupiter-Perps position at 20x by default, with borrow fees, open/close fees, slippage, maintenance margin and intrabar liquidation.

strategies.name: Leverage tier, low margin
strategies.summary: Runs any registered long/flat strategy as a Jupiter-Perps position at 2x by default, with borrow fees, open/close fees, slippage, maintenance margin and intrabar liquidation.

strategies.name: Leverage tier, medium margin
strategies.summary: Runs any registered long/flat strategy as a Jupiter-Perps position at 5x by default, with borrow fees, open/close fees, slippage, maintenance margin and intrabar liquidation.

strategies.name: Moving-Average Crossover
strategies.summary: Long while a fast SMA sits above a slow SMA. The canonical trend-following rule.

strategies.name: Moving-Average Ribbon
strategies.summary: Exposure scales with the fraction of adjacent MA pairs in correct order.

strategies.name: MACD Crossover
strategies.summary: Long while the MACD line is above its signal line. Momentum of the gap between two EMAs.

strategies.name: On-Balance Volume Trend
strategies.summary: Long while cumulative signed volume is above its own moving average. Price-blind by construction.

strategies.name: OU Half-Life Reversion (screened and hold-capped)
strategies.summary: Z-score reversion with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck hold cap and a stationarity screening rule.

strategies.name: Percentage Price Oscillator cross
strategies.summary: Long while the PPO line is above its signal line. MACD divided by the slow EMA, so readings are comparable across price levels.

strategies.name: RSI Mean-Reversion
strategies.summary: Buy when Wilder's RSI is oversold, exit when it recovers past a midline. Stateful hold between.

strategies.name: Slow-MA Regime Filter
strategies.summary: Long above a slow moving average, flat below it. The most valuable partner in the set.

strategies.name: Stochastic Oscillator with Turn-Up Confirmation
strategies.summary: Long when %K is oversold AND already above %D, so the turn has visibly begun.

strategies.name: Swing Trade Breakout with Confluence
strategies.summary: Enter a breakout above the prior N-bar high when at least two of SMA, MACD, RSI and OBV agree; exit below the prior M-bar low.

strategies.name: Reliable-trigger trade
strategies.summary: Waits for a conjunction of causal conditions, enters at the next bar open in the predicted direction, exits when the horizon expires or a MAE-derived stop is hit.

strategies.name: Time-Series Momentum
strategies.summary: Long when the trailing n-bar return is positive. The Moskowitz/Ooi/Pedersen time-series form.

strategies.name: Volatility-Regime Switch (tercile, not HMM)
strategies.summary: Trend-follow in calm volatility, stand aside when volatility is elevated.

strategies.name: Volatility-Targeted Trend
strategies.summary: Trend entry sized inversely to realised volatility. Continuous exposure, not binary.

strategies.name: Rolling VWAP Reversion
strategies.summary: Buy a discount to rolling volume-weighted average price, exit on reversion.

strategies.name: Z-Score Mean-Reversion
strategies.summary: Buy when price is z sample-stdevs below its trailing mean. Top-ranked medium single, at the evidence floor.
